insights.description: OrderController.cancelOrder provides the entry point for order cancellation.
OrderService.cancelOrder contains the business logic to update the order status and coordinate inventory release.
InventoryService.releaseReservation handles the release of the reserved stock.
Order entity stores the status of the order which is updated to CANCELLED.
The requirement does not specify whether the user should be refunded, or if payment was already captured.
The requirement does not specify if partial order cancellations are allowed.
The requirement does not specify what should happen to the order if the inventory release fails.
The requirement does not specify whether inventory release should happen synchronously or asynchronously via events.
